page.layout: One page of text: a single column of index entries, numbered at the left, with page numbers at the right. The heading INDEX stands centred at the top. A cut-off entry 27 at the foot.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.l: 1 Utrum ad Metaphysicam pertineat agere de causis & quomodo? 211
2 An causa & principium idem omnino sint? 212
3 Quid sit causa in genere? 213
4 An causa recte dicatur alia potentia, alia actu? 215
5 An omnis causa prior sit suo causato? ibid.
6 An posita causa semper ponatur causatum, & sublata collatur? 217
7 An qualis causa, tale semper sit causatū[?], & vice versa? 219
8 An quatuor dunt axat[?] sint causarum genera? ibid.
9 An quadrimembris causarum distributio commode ad bi-
membrem revocari possit? 221
10 An omne causatum indigeat quatuor causarum generi-
bus ad sui productionem? 222
11 An aliquid possit esse causa sui ipsius? 223
12 An omne causatum realiter differat ab omnibus suis cau-

l.i: sis tum separatim, tum coniunctim acceptis?

main_text.l: 13 Utrum causae possint esse sibi invicem causae? 224
14 An unum & idem ens diverso respectu possit rationem di-
15 An ex quatuor causis alia aliis sint perfectiores? 225
16 An detur necessaria connexio inter causas quatuor gene-
17 An unius & eiusdem causati possint dari plures causae in
unoquoque causarum genere? 226
18 An in unoquoque causarum genere detur certus aliquis ordo, & quomodo? 227
19 An in causis per se subordinatis detur progressus in infini-
tum? 228
20 An necesse sit causas per se subordinatas omnes simul actu
concurrere ad causandum suum causatum? 229
21 An in causis per se subordinatis superior semper nobilio-

l.i: rem & perfectiorem causandi virtutem habeat quam inferior?

main_text.l: 22 An proxima causa semper praesupponat omnes remotas?
23 An unius causa semper unum tantum sit causatum? 231
24 An causatum possit esse perfectius suis causis? ibid.
25 An in unoquoque causarum genere locum habeat distri-
butio causae in totalem & partialem? 232
26 Quid sit finis in genere? 233
27 An

page.notes: No page number is printed at the head or foot. The entry at 27 is cut off at the foot of the page, so only "An" is legible. Doubtful readings: "causatū" in entry 7 and "dunt axat" in entry 8, which may be printed as one word, are marked [?]. Page numbers in the right column are read from a faint scan and may be slightly off. A library stamp at the bottom right is left out.
